metric_contract.common_support_availability: valid scored epochs / nominal 1 ms epochs in each frozen interval
metric_contract.first_alarm: earliest supported strict-threshold alarm at or after each boundary
metric_contract.pauc_0_05: sklearn standardized partial ROC AUC with max_fpr=0.05

persistent_alarm_ratio.bins: non-overlapping complete bins anchored at 195.0 s
persistent_alarm_ratio.reported_value: passing bins / complete bins with at least one supported epoch
